notes.title: Steam Game Festival Free Demo
notes.content:
Hi, everyone! We’re glad to announce that Super Rhythm Duel will participate in the upcoming [b]Steam Game Festival[/b] during [b]June 16 to June 22[/b]. In that period, the free demo of Super Rhythm Duel will be available for everyone. The demo is only a tiny part of the full game for showcasing the basic mechanics. We’re still working on the full project. Hope you’ll enjoy our game!
